## Batch 23 authored

Added the A/B pages and eight draft items. The main theorem proves a second-order weighted grid-\(L^2\) error bound from a discrete energy estimate and an explicit variable-flux residual bound. The four examples cover quadratic exactness, flux-versus-expanded stencils, first-order Neumann closure error, and a uniform inverse bound.

Seven items have current `ready` records. The error theorem is `escalated` because batch 5’s required NA-19 page has no authored items or supplier body to inspect. Its local proof is complete, but the declared page dependency remains open.

The batch manifest, proof contracts, source coverage, cross-batch record, and notes are in [batch-23.pages.json](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/numerical-optimization-dynamics-2026-10-16-batch-23.pages.json), [proof-contracts.json](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/numerical-optimization-dynamics-2026-10-16-batch-23.proof-contracts.json), [coverage.json](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/numerical-optimization-dynamics-2026-10-16-batch-23.coverage.json), [cross-batch-dependencies.json](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/numerical-optimization-dynamics-2026-10-16-batch-23.cross-batch-dependencies.json), and [notes.md](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/numerical-optimization-dynamics-2026-10-16-batch-23.notes.md).
